Class IceAndFireCompat

java.lang.Object
com.github.crittscott.somegoogly.client.compat.IceAndFireCompat
public final class IceAndFireCompat extends Object
Optional bridge to Ice and Fire Community Edition's mob renderers. Its mobs draw Uranus models, which are not vanilla EntityModels, from LegacyMobRenderer, a plain EntityRenderer rather than a LivingEntityRenderer, so neither the vanilla eye layer nor the living render-state hook reaches them. Instead each such renderer is given one of its own LegacyEntityFeatures through its public addLayer, built as a reflective proxy so there is no compile-time dependency.

The renderer runs its features inside the same base model pose LivingEntityRenderer gives its layers, right after posing the model's shared boxes for this entity and before another entity of the type can re-pose them, so attachments resolve against this entity's pose. The renderer extracts no living render state, so the eye decision is taken from the live entity the feature receives, at submit time, where the renderer itself reads it.

The cockatrice's renderer is built directly on EntityRenderer and has no features; IceAndFireModelRendererMixin calls submitAfterModel(EntityRenderer, LivingEntityRenderState, PoseStack, SubmitNodeCollector) from inside its submit instead. It draws one of two static models, chosen by age.
